messages:
Maya: Hotfix ready for embed auth token refresh bug found in canary. Image=gcr.io/redwood/serve:hotfix-auth-2026-03-24-v1. Need fast approvals to try canary in prod. Proposed plan: canary 8% for 8m -> 50% -> 100%. Rollback if auth-401 > 0.4% or p95 +12%. @ops-oncall on standby.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: id=1827000000 image=hotfix-auth-2026-03-24-v1 target=prod/embed-route strategy=canary(8%,8m)->50%->100%. To start: `/deploy start 1827000000 --canary 8m`. Runbook: /runbooks/embed-auth-hotfix.

Noah: +1 from QA for fastpath after staging smoke. I'll watch logs and traces.

Sara: ops note: cordon one canary node, set alert for auth-401 >0.3% to escalate faster.

ops-oncall: standing by. If breach happens call rollback and I'll execute.

Maya: starting `/deploy start 1827000000 --canary 8m --image hotfix-auth-2026-03-24-v1`. Pinning image to deploy id.

deploy-bot: canary_started: 8% traffic -> 4 pods in us-west1+eu-west1. Hooks: auth-401-rate, p95, error_5xx.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ +3m: auth-401-rate 0.15%, p95 +2%.

Noah: traces look clean.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ +7m: auth-401-rate 0.5% (threshold 0.4%). Alert triggered.

Sara: threshold breached. ops-oncall, recommend soft drain first.

ops-oncall: initiate drain now. If metrics don't drop within 90s proceed with full rollback.

deploy-bot: draining canary pods and shifting traffic away.

Maya: running quick smoke to validate rollback behavior.

deploy-bot: Drain complete. auth-401-rate returned to baseline 0.12%. Canary pods terminated.

Tariq: thanks. Pinning failing image to incident and adding build logs. Will open a follow-up PR with extra guardrails and add unit for race.

Noah: +1 on tests. Good quick decision.

ops-oncall: systems stable. Closing out expedited approval loop. Filing incident and scheduling postmortem. :white_check_mark:
